nodes.name: Prepare Source for Cleaning
nodes.notes: Creates one processing-run key for the current article supplied by the one-at-a-time loop.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'google/gemma-4-12b-qat', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.p1_lm_cleaning_prompt }], temperature: 0.1, max_tokens: 4096, reasoning_effort: 'none' } }}

nodes.name: Clean Article with LM Studio API
nodes.notes: Calls LM Studio directly so reasoning_effort: none is always sent. Change the model ID here when you choose another loaded model.

nodes.name: Save Completed Phase 1 Source
nodes.notes: Marks the current source completed after its cleaner result is saved.

nodes.name: Prepare Failed Attempt
nodes.notes: Keeps one failed LM Studio request from stopping the rest of the queue.

nodes.name: Save Failed Phase 1 Source
nodes.notes: Marks the current source failed after its LM Studio request errors, then returns to the loop.

nodes.name: Get Queued or Failed Sources
nodes.notes: Uses the regular Supabase node to fetch all queued and failed sources for this owner-triggered run.

nodes.name: Process One Source at a Time
nodes.notes: Explicitly sends one article at a time through LM Studio. The completed and failed paths return here for the next article.

nodes.name: When I Click Execute Workflow
nodes.notes: Start this workflow manually from the n8n editor whenever you want to process all queued and failed articles.

nodes.name: Has Nonempty Cleaned Text
nodes.notes: Prevents an empty cleaner result from being saved as completed. Empty results enter the failed/retry path.
